ruleName: Repair of Damage on Putting Green
title: Repairing Pitch Marks on the Putting Green
question: Lucy's ball lies on the fringe and she intends to putt. There is a pitch mark on her line of play, and the pitch mark itself is on the putting green. May Lucy repair it?

choices.text: Only with the agreement of another player.
Only if her ball also lies on the green.

explanation: Lucy is allowed to repair damage such as pitch marks on the putting green, even if her ball is not on the green. The Rules permit the repair of damage on the green that is on the line of play for any player, regardless of where their ball lies.
